name: Event details(Testing)
query:
SELECT er.email, er.event_date, er.participant, p.participant_name, ed.name, ed.event_name
FROM `tabEvent Registration` AS er
INNER JOIN `tabParticipant` AS p
ON p.name = er.participant
Inner JOIN `tabEvent Detail` AS ed
ON ed.name = er.event_detail
WHERE er.docstatus = 0;
